title: Late delivery reply
prompt:
Write a support reply of 35 to 85 words. The order will arrive tomorrow. Say the delivery is late. Do not admit fault and do not guarantee a refund.

Requirements:
- Use the words late, order, and tomorrow.
- Do not write "our fault" or "refund guaranteed".
- Do not include a card number.
constraints: Does not admit fault or guarantee a refund
